outer_script: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'; try { $p=Start-Process -FilePath 'C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe' -Verb RunAs -ArgumentList @('-NoLogo','-NoProfile','-NonInteractive','-EncodedCommand','') -PassThru; [ordered]@{launched=$true;process_id=$p.Id;utc=[DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString('o')} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress } catch { [ordered]@{launched=$false;error=$_.Exception.Message;utc=[DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString('o')} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress; exit 1 }
